The '''bramblefish''' was a type of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] found on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]]. They could be giant in size.<ref name="CatCW" />

{{RPGseed}}
At one point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], a group of adventurers on Velusia searching for a lost [[aquascout]] were forced to contend with a gigantic bramblefish that was attracted by the shine of the adventurers' own aquascout.<ref name="CatCW" />
{{Endgame}}
